details: For finite classes, by the definition of effective VC radius.
proof: Let $d=\mathrm{VCR}(\mathcal H)$ and let $T$ be a teaching set of size less than $d$; coordinates outside the effective range may be discarded.  Extend $T$ to a $d$-subset $S$ of the effective range.  Since $S$ is shattered, there is a concept other than the target that agrees with it on $T$ and differs on a point of $S\setminus T$, contradicting that $T$ teaches the target.  Thus every teaching set has size at least $d$.
name: Minimum Teaching Set Size / Effective VC Radius
